_about: Public-domain Hugh McNeile (1795-1879), evangelical Anglican rector in Liverpool and Dean of Ripon, for the Word Hoard: The Times of the Gentiles (1828), England's Protest is England's Shield (1829), Popular Lectures on the Prophecies relative to the Jewish Nation (1830), Letters to a Friend who has Felt it his Duty to Secede (1834), Lectures on the Church of England (1840), Sermons on the Second Advent (1840), A Lecture on the Life of Dr. Franklin (1841) and The Church and the Churches (1846), from Internet Archive scans. Alan Hugh McNeile (1871-1933), the Cambridge commentator, is another man. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
